buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Mandatory Submission of Samples The bidder shall be required to submit physical samples of each and every item quoted in the bid fo r inspection and evaluation by the concerned Department/Committee. Submission of samples is mandatory and shall be applicable to all items, without any exception. Each sample must be properly labelled with the bidder's name, item description, make, brand, model number and corresponding BOQ/item serial number.

Bidder/Oem must upload a Excel of all items providing the image of each item and rates. Samples must be identical to the specifications, quality, dimensions, material, finish and other technical p arameters offered in the bid. The samples shall be submitted at the designated office/location of the purchaser within the stipulated ti me communicated by the Department. Failure to submit samples of any quoted item within the prescribed timeline shall render the bidder liable for technical disqualification. The Department reserves the right to inspect, test, compare and evaluate the submitted samples before f inalizing the technical evaluation. Any deviation between the submitted sample and the specifications/description offered in the bid may res ult in rejection of the concerned item or disqualification of the bidder. The decision of the duly constituted Technical Evaluation Committee regarding sample approval shall be final and binding, subject to applicable procurement rules. The approved sample shall serve as the quality benchmark for the entire supply. The supplied materi al must strictly conform to the approved sample. Mandatory Submission of Complete Company Catalogue Every bidder must upload a complete and original company product catalogue along with the techni cal bid. The catalogue must cover the entire range of products manufactured/marketed by the company, inc luding the specific items required under the present tender. The relevant products offered against the tender must be clearly highlighted or marked in the catalogue for easy identification and technical verification. The catalogue must contain clear product photographs, product descriptions, make, brand, model numb ers, dimensions, material specifications and other relevant technical details wherever applicable. The catalogue must be in PDF format, properly indexed and legible. The bidder shall not submit only loose product photographs, self-prepared product sheets or incomplete ex tracts in place of the complete company catalogue. The catalogue must be authentic and traceable to the concerned manufacturer/company. The purchaser r eserves the right to verify its authenticity directly from the manufacturer. In case of non-submission, incomplete submission, misleading information or failure to establish the offere d product's conformity with the required specifications, the bid shall be liable for rejection. General Conditions Submission of samples and complete company catalogue is a mandatory technical qualification requ irement. Price quotations alone shall not establish the technical eligibility of any bidder. The purchaser reserves the right to seek clarification or additional technical documents wherever re quired, without compromising the principles of fair competition. No bidder shall be permitted to exempt from EMD Submission. No bidder shall be permitted to substitute the approved sample with a different product at the time of ac

tual supply. Any attempt to submit misleading catalogues, manipulated product photographs or samples different fr om the offered products may lead to rejection of the bid and further action as per applicable procuremen t rules. OEM must be enclosed confirming that installation, commissioning, and pressure testing will be carri ed out by certified engineers . 3.
